result.title: AI-Experiment: an augmented reality art project co-created with artificial intelligence
result.comment: presented and published at AI for Visual Arts Workshop and Challenges (AI4VA) in conjunction with European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026, Malmö, Sweden
result.summary: We describe the creation of a physical artwork that was performed in synergy between an artist, a computer scientist and generative AI tools. A latent diffusion model was finetuned on photographs of the artwork of the specific artist and the generative model then generated synthetic artworks in a similar style. From the generated artworks a subset was selected to be painted again with acrylic on canvas by the original artist. In addition to the physical artifact an augmented reality component was added which brings the artwork to life with a set of generative video models. Together with this paper we release part of the artwork (training data), the code that was deployed to generate the artwork as well as the augmented reality experience for arts, research and education under https://github.com/BernhardEgger/ARTimate

AI.brief_summary: 该工作是一个艺术创作项目：艺术家、计算机科学家与生成式 AI 协作，用特定艺术家作品照片微调 latent diffusion 模型生成同风格图像，再由艺术家挑选并绘制成丙烯画，并附加生成式视频驱动的 AR 体验。
AI.relevance_reason: 仅出现「latent diffusion」这一术语相似，属于图像生成与 AR 艺术应用，不涉及 VLM 推理状态、视觉证据筛选或推理决策，缺少可迁移的状态、训练或评价线索，故排除。
